results.title: [PDF] Building & Construction Award (MA000020) Pay Rates 2026/27
results.description:
# Building & Construction Award (MA000020) — Pay Rates 2026/27
## Adult classification rates
| Level | Typical roles | Weekly | Ordinary /hr | Casual /hr |
|-|-|-|-|-|
| Construction worker 1 (CW/ECW 1) | Construction/general labourer & trades assistant (sub-levels a–d $28.44–$29.82) | $1080.65 | $28.44 | $35.55 |
| Construction worker 2 (CW/ECW 2) | Experienced labourer / plant or equipment operator | $1154.65 | $30.39 | $37.99 |
| Construction worker 3 (CW/ECW 3) | Tradesperson — carpenter, joiner, bricklayer, painter, plasterer, tiler (variants $31.48–$32.30) | $1227.47 | $32.30 | $40.38 |
| Construction worker 4 (CW/ECW 4) | Special-class trade — signwriter, joiner special class, letter cutter | $1231.44 | $32.41 | $40.51 |
| Construction worker 5 (CW/ECW 5) | Advanced special-class trade — refractory/special-class bricklayer, special-class plasterer | $1286.01 | $33.84 | $42.30 |
| Construction worker 6 (CW/ECW 6) | Advanced/engineering construction worker | $1288.45 | $33.91 | $42.39 |
| Construction worker 7 (CW/ECW 7) | Higher engineering construction worker | $1323.45 | $34.83 | $43.54 |
| Construction worker 8 (CW/ECW 8) | Top construction-stream worker (e.g. carpenter-diver); the parallel engineering stream tops out at ECW 9 ($36.23/hr) | $1395.07 | $36.71 | $45.89 |

_Casual /hr includes the 25% casual loading on ordinary hours._

## Penalty rates
| When worked | Full-time / part-time | Casual |
|-|-|-|
| Saturday (first 2 hours) | $42.66 (150%) | $49.77 (175%) |
| Sunday | $56.88 (200%) | $63.99 (225%) |
| Public holiday | $71.10 (250%) | $78.21 (275%) |

_Dollar figures are for Construction worker 1 (CW/ECW 1)._ _Other levels scale from their own ordinary rate above._

## Common allowances
| Allowance | Amount |
|-|-|
| Industry allowance (all-purpose) | All-purpose — already included in the ordinary rates above (general building sector) |
| Tool allowance (all-purpose) | All-purpose — included in the trade rates above where the trade must supply tools |
| Fares and travel allowance | $22.41 per day (apprentices $16.81-$21.29 per day by year) |
| Leading hand allowance | 2.4% (1 employee) or 5.3% (2-5 employees) of the highest classification supervised |
| First aid allowance | $4.03 per day (minimum qualification) or $6.38 per day (higher qualification) |

| Electrician's licence allowance | $0.94 per hour (all-purpose) |
|-|-|
| Multistorey allowance | $0.94 per hour for work above 15 metres (plus $0.94 for each additional 15 m band) |
| In charge of plant allowance | $52.60 per week |
| Air-conditioning industry allowance | $88.41 per week (air-conditioning/refrigeration tradesperson) |
| Living away from home allowance (distant work) | $102.92 per day where not required to live in camp (or provided board), plus $45.36 per weekend return home |
